calendar_truncated: This range has more posts than the calendar can show, so some are missing. Pick a shorter range to see them all.
calendar_load_failed: The calendar couldn't be loaded. Try again.
calendar_move_hint: Shift and the arrow keys move this post by a day or a week. All of its channels move together.
calendar_move_in_past: That time has already passed. Pick a later day.
calendar_move_changed: Someone else changed this post in the meantime. The calendar now shows the latest version.
calendar_move_approval: This post needs an approval before it can be moved.
calendar_move_unavailable: This post can't be moved right now. It may already be publishing.
calendar_move_failed: The post couldn't be moved. Try again.
home_empty_body: Posts you schedule will show up here.
calendar_move_reapproval: That time is outside the approved window, so the post needs approval again.
calendar_import_title: Import posts from a CSV file
calendar_import_intro: Each row becomes one post. Use the columns text, channels, date and time; only text is required. A row without a date and time goes to each channel's queue.
calendar_import_channels_hint: For rows whose channels column is empty. In the column, list channel handles separated by commas or spaces.
calendar_import_no_channels: No channel can publish a text-only post.

match.countPlural=one: {count} problem to fix. Fix the file and pick it again.
match.countPlural=*: {count} problems to fix. Fix the file and pick it again.

calendar_import_error_column: Unknown column “{name}”. Use text, channels, date and time.
calendar_import_error_text_column: The file needs a text column.

match.countPlural=one: The file has more than {count} post. Split it into smaller files.
match.countPlural=*: The file has more than {count} posts. Split it into smaller files.

calendar_import_error_fields: This row has more fields than the header.
calendar_import_error_handle_twice: More than one channel has the handle “{handle}”.
calendar_import_error_channels: Fill in the channels column or pick default channels.
calendar_import_error_date: Use a date like 2026-12-31 and a time like 09:30.
calendar_import_error_date_half: Fill in both the date and the time, or leave both empty.
calendar_import_example_first: Hello! This post goes out at the date and time given.
calendar_import_example_queue: This post takes the next free slot in the queue.
